meta.name: Code 2600
meta.description: Code 2600documents the beginnings of the ‘info-tech’ Age, as told by some of the people who helped build and manipulate it, and through some key events that have shaped its trajectory. The film explores some of the impacts, both good and bad, that the new connectivity of the telephone system, computers, and later the Internet, has had on our ability to remain human while maintaining our personal privacy, security, and dignity.
